# Steam — which characters can search bodies?

- Original source: [Steam — which characters can search bodies?](https://steamcommunity.com/app/46560/discussions/0/598527888848874590/)
- Author / publication: Hyp3™ ♿, ska♛, and Mr.Kitchee / Steam Community
- Language / date: English; opened 2025-05-27; later reply shows August 8 without year
- Access: Opening and both replies inspected through direct HTML retrieval
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Format: original summary and research notes; not a transcript.

The opener asks whether only certain bodies can be searched or whether a key binding is missing. The first reply points to character abilities, and the second explicitly names Robin Hood and Maid Marian as able to search bodies.

The exchange helps distinguish selecting a suitable character from assuming every defeated enemy carries loot. It does not document loot availability, body-state restrictions, or edition differences.

Treat the character list as a community answer to compare with the existing ability guides. No gameplay verification or follow-up confirmation from the opener appears in the inspected thread.
